plant.description:
Flaring of gas at the chemical plant Rheinland Raffinerie in Wesseling, Germany: 
In the chemical industry, flares are usually used for the safe removal of combustible gases that do not occur continuously. The use is often as a high torch.
When industrial plant equipment items are over-pressured, the pressure relief valve is an essential safety device that automatically release gases and sometimes liquids. Those pressure relief valves are required by industrial design codes and standards as well as by law.

crops.author: Lance Cheung/USDA
crops.description: Mastronardi Produce, Coldwater, MI, on April 3, 2018. Founded by Umberto Mastronardi more than 60 years ago, the fourth generation of the Mastronardi family owns and manages a year-round operation of greenhouses that produce tomatoes, peppers and cucumbers. Vine-ripened produce is harvested by hand when possible. The greenhouses use modern technology and sustainable growing practices to reduce the impact on the environment (i.e. they use one-tenth the water of a conventional grower). Their second phase of greenhouses use diffused glass, energy curtains, grow lights to help in the winter months, automated harvest carts for ergonomic harvesting, recycled water and fertilizer, and a rainwater irrigation system.

port.title: File:Senator Kiko Pangilinan inspects the ₱86 million onions at the Manila International Container Port.jpg
port.alt: Senator Kiko Pangilinan inspects the ₱86 million onions at the Manila International Container Port
port.author: Senator Kiko Pangilinan
port.description:
INSPEKSYON SA ₱86-M NA IMPORTED NA SIBUYAS SA MICP
Ngayong umaga, June 10, kasama natin ang Department of Agriculture (DA), Bureau of Customs (BOC), at Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) sa isinagawang inspeksyon ng 26 containers na naglalaman ng tinatayang ₱86 milyong halaga ng imported red onions sa Manila International Container Port (MICP).
Habang nabubulok ang sibuyas ng ating mga magsasaka, ito namang imported onions ay nabulok din matapos maiwan at hindi ma-claim. Kung ganito ang nangyayari, kailangan nating tanungin kung bakit may pumapasok pang ganitong kalaking volume ng imported onions sa kabila ng sapat na lokal na suplay.
Kung lehitimo ang shipment na ito, bakit iniwan na lamang at hindi na-claim? Bakit hindi binayaran ang kaukulang buwis at mga bayarin? Dapat masagot ito upang mapanagot ang mga nasa likod nito at maprotektahan ang ating mga magsasaka.
Bakit tayo mag-iimport kung marami ngang supply dito sa atin? Ito ang tanong na paulit-ulit na lumabas sa ating public hearing. Ang pagpasok ng imported onions sa panahon ng oversupply ay lalo lamang nagpapabagsak sa presyo at nagpapahirap sa ating mga magsasaka.

Hindi dapat nabubulok ang sibuyas ng ating mga magsasaka, at hindi rin dapat nasasayang ang mga produktong pumapasok sa bansa. Ang kailangan natin ay maayos na pamamahala ng suplay, mahigpit na pagpapatupad ng batas, at mga polisiyang inuuna ang kapakanan ng ating mga magsasaka.

handwash.description:
These handwashing facilities are based on a common Rwandan model - there is one tank for water and another for liquid soap. These are both operated by pressing down on a foot pedal. Typically Oxfam just installs a single washstand holding water with soap kept by the sink. However, in a busy camp soap can often go missing, so this innovation of having a separate tap with liquid soap means that soap supplies are always available.

Photo: Laura Eldon/Oxfam

programming.description: This is a programmer for the Microchip "PIC" family of microcontrollers, as sold in 2003.  In use the RS 232 serial cable would connect the programmer to an IBM PC compatible computer running development software. The PIC device to be programmed would be inserted in the zero-insertion-force socket on the programmer. This programmer was intended for education, experimental or low-cost prototype development. High volume programmers had more programming sockets, tighter control of programming parameters, and would be of sturdier construction. In 2003 this unit sold for $300 Canadian (about $200 US at the time).

This is a core through part of the New Albany Shale, a Devonian-aged formation in Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois, and eastern Missouri.  The unit is dominated by dark-colored marine mudshales of Late Devonian age.  These black shales were deposited in a moderately deep, anoxic seafloor environment.  This was a widespread lithofacies during the Late Devonian's Global Anoxia Event.  The New Albany Shale is equivalent to the Ohio Shale, the Antrim Shale, and the Chattanooga Shale in surrounding states.
The New Albany Shale's member terminology varies from region to region.  In southwestern Indiana, where this core was drilled, the New Albany consists of (from the base upward): Blocher Member, Selmier Member, Morgan Trail Member, Camp Run Member, and Clegg Creek Member.


Caption that accompanied this particular core display:
At the top of the Selmier occurs an abrupt change from gray bioturbated shale to massive, banded, and pyritic black shale.  The knife-sharp contact corresponds to a sharp increase in gamma-ray counts and marks the erosive contact between the Selmier Member and the overlying Morgan Trail Member.  Based on conodont studies on comparable strata, the boundary between the Selmier and Morgan Trail Members coincides with the Frasnian-Famennian boundary.


Stratigraphy: Morgan Trail Member (left) over Selmier Member (center & right), New Albany Shale, uppermost Frasnian Stage to lowermost Famennian Stage, middle Upper Devonian

Vollm. "specializing" on pines and sometimes choosing larch and spruce, and V. album subsp. abietis (Wiesb.) Janch.) parasitizing firs. dairy.author: William Murphy from Dublin, Ireland
dairy.description: « Le Balmo », voor de vaste klanten, is al geruime tijd de « place to be » op het Brugmannplein. U wordt hier steeds hartelijk verwelkomd in een prachtig authentiek decor dat zo de sfeer van de sixties oproept en werd aangekleed in ware hollywood-stijl: glamoureuze roze en turkooizen skai zetels, geëmailleerde platen, pin ups en muziek uit de jaren 60. Op de kaart vindt u allerlei klassiekers made in USA. Hamburgers, club sandwiches, spare ribs, pancakes, cookies, brownies en cheesecake. De liefhebbers van de Tex Mex keuken vinden hier ook beslist hun gading, zij kunnen genieten van heerlijke fajitas, tacos en andere burritos tenzij zij uiteraard eerder een salade of een erg smaakvolle pastaschotel verkiezen. Een bezoekje aan Le Balmoral is ook de ideale gelegenheid om verse vruchtensapjes en milkshakes te degusteren en zo extra veel vitamines op te doen. Ook de allerkleinsten worden hier niet vergeten… Speciaal voor hen werd een speelruimte ingericht, voorzien van een Playstation, krijtbord en allerlei leuke speeltjes zodat ze een onvergetelijk moment doorbrengen. Bovendien werd een kaart op maat voor hen samengesteld. De mama’s hoeven zelfs geen papjes te maken, want deze staan eveneens op het menu! Vrijdagavond kunt u zich hier helemaal ontspannen met familie of onder vrienden, terwijl u een aflevering van Star Ac’ of een leuke film meepikt op groot scherm. Kortom, er heerst steeds een gezellige, ontspannen en ongedwongen sfeer! In de zomer is het dan weer heerlijk vertoeven op het terras. Le Balmoral blijft een ideale plek om andere mensen te ontmoeten en waar u ook zelf gezien wordt! Open van dinsdag tot zondag van 9u. tot 20u., vrijdag van 9u. tot 22u.00, gesloten op maandag.

timber.title: File:Sawmill Geyser erupting (11 22-11 34 AM, 2 June 2013) 34 (13748061034).jpg
timber.author: James St. John
timber.description:
Geysers are hot springs that episodically erupt columns of water. They occur in few places on Earth. The highest concentration of geysers anywhere is in the Yellowstone Hotspot Volcano (northwestern Wyoming, USA).

Sawmill Geyser is the namesake of the Sawmill Group in Yellowstone's Upper Geyser Basin.  It is a frequently erupting fountain-type geyser, typically with long durations.  Eruptions consist of brief but overlapping, medium-sized spikes of water.  As of late January 2017, Sawmill Geyser has become dormant, which is unusual.
